review.summary: The odd check is incorrect for negative odd values.

findings.title: Negative odd values rejected
findings.explanation: A negative odd remainder is -1, so the expression returns false for negative odd inputs.
findings.suggested_fix: Use value % 2 != 0 when any odd integer should return true.

review.summary: The copied string and terminator exceed the header buffer.

findings.title: String copy overflow
findings.explanation: "yes" requires four bytes including its null terminator while header has three.
findings.suggested_fix: Increase the buffer or use a bounded operation with a correctly sized destination.

findings.title: Wrong non-ready status
findings.explanation: The false branch returns 201, which represents successful creation rather than an unavailable resource.
findings.suggested_fix: Return 503 in the false branch when the resource is not ready.

review.summary: Short names can produce an invalid substring position.
assumptions: name can contain fewer than four characters.

findings.title: Suffix check underflows for short names
findings.explanation: name.size() - 4 wraps for a short name, so substr receives an invalid position and throws.
findings.suggested_fix: Check name.size() >= 4 before subtracting, then compare the suffix.
